continuesFrom.note: Continues Run-2.1. Weights loaded trainable; a bounded register correction, not a new run.

reason: Run-2 corpus had zero consensual-adult-register coverage, so the base alignment prior surfaced as an invented refusal on licensed turns. This teaches Plan/4 stance fidelity in that register with replay.

corpus.note: Reissued Run-2 corpus, unchanged. Replay only.

supplement.composition: consensual-adult register; plan-directed stance fidelity across 8 acts, 6 registers, 11 stances

baseModel.note: Identical base and revision to run-1a/1b/1c. Holding the base fixed is what makes the Run-1c comparison a measurement of the corpus and the prompt format rather than of the weights underneath.

deviationsFromRun2.reason: Run-2 trained a zero-initialised adapter; this continues one that already works. Continuing at 1e-4 would move the weights further than a one-composition correction warrants and undo the run being corrected.
A bounded correction over a mixture that is 85% replay. A second epoch mostly re-teaches what the model already knows while giving the supplement four more passes at it.

94 supplement rows beside 1,616 replay rows is 5.5%, too dilute to learn from. Oversampling to ~15% makes it learnable; the 25% ceiling makes the run refuse rather than let the correction become the corpus.

deviationsFromRun2.run21Value: targeted validation must improve AND main validation must not regress beyond 0.02
deviationsFromRun2.reason: One validation set cannot distinguish a correction from a trade. A checkpoint that fixes the composition by damaging everything else would win on the targeted set alone.

knownCorpusDefect.issue: The frozen JSONL files carry a UTF-8 BOM, so json.loads fails on the first line of each file for any reader that does not use utf-8-sig.
knownCorpusDefect.handling: Readers here open with utf-8-sig. The corpus is approved and frozen at e07d9d5 and was NOT modified; this is recorded for the next freeze.
